text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"Vitamin D supplementation corrects deficiency and improves bone mineral density in adults with low baseline serum levels.","cited_pids":["vitamin_d#0"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"Daily vitamin D supplementation in deficient populations improves muscle strength and reduces falls.","cited_pids":["vitamin_d#3"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"A meta-analysis reports a modest fracture benefit in older adults when vitamin D is combined with calcium.","cited_pids":["vitamin_d#1"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"A Cochrane review found no reduction in all-cause mortality in adults who are not deficient at baseline receiving vitamin D.","cited_pids":["vitamin_d#5"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"The VITAL trial found no significant effect of vitamin D supplementation on cardiovascular events or cancer.","cited_pids":["vitamin_d#4"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"Routine vitamin D supplementation in adults with adequate levels showed no measurable outcome improvement.","cited_pids":["vitamin_d#6"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"High-dose vitamin D has been linked to hypercalcaemia and, in some trials, to increased fall risk.","cited_pids":["vitamin_d#7"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Observational links between vitamin D and fewer infections are associational only.","cited_pids":["vitamin_d#2"]},{"cid":"c9","text":"Daily vitamin D use seems most justified for adults who are deficient.","cited_pids":[]}]}
